title: NIEZWYCIĘŻONA [SEMPER INVICTA]
author: Naarel
description:
WARNING: this work features references to World War 2 and a gunshot as a sound effect.

(Capital City of) Warsaw

pol. (Miasto Stołeczne) Warszawa

Also known as: The Phoenix City

Motto: Semper Invicta (lat. Ever Invincible)

Warsaw is, quite possibly, one of the most traumatized and retraumatized cities in Poland. It's also a place where thousands of people travel to in order to change their lives. You are one of them.

And Warsaw loves you.

Made for Velox Fabula 3, theme: Sentient City/Setting. Use provided buttons or space to progress.
